name: synaphony
source:
Have you ever looked at someone and wondered... What is going on inside their head?

Well, thanks to technological advances, we're able to do exactly that and more! Watch the world through the lens of three selected individuals, facing vastly different lifestyles. Not only will you watch their lives, you'd also be able to live their lives. You, uniquely, have the ability to change their fate! 

How they execute your choices, however... isn't guaranteed to be perfect. Nobody's perfect, after all! 

Unfortunately, we're on a time-crunch here. So, based on your 3 days of observation, you must carefully evaluate the morality of the subjects. Here’s a few thought-provoking questions to help you start!

* What does it mean to be a good person?
* Is our access to morality dictated by our environment? Or does the environment shape our access to morality?
* Are they really a good person, if they aren’t making their own decisions? 

Take these questions as a starting point, rather than a code to follow. We trust your judgment. Have a great day at work!
